figures.finding: The Film Development Fund's Film Production Financing Scheme 2.0 (from 15 January 2025, not time-limited) finances films budgeted at no more than HK$25 million: every application with a passing score gets 40% of the approved budget, capped at HK$10 million, 70% of it paid when principal photography starts, with investors recovering half their investment first; the 2020-2025 Relaxation Plan funded 23 films.

value.scheme: Film Production Financing Scheme 2.0 (Film Development Fund)
conditions: applicant, producer or director has at least two released films
all directors Hong Kong permanent residents
at least 50% of below-the-line spend in Hong Kong
licensing fees no more than 10% of production cost

figures.applies: Hong Kong film projects from 15 January 2025.

sources.said: All applications with passing scores will be provided with the maximum financing amount, i.e. 40 per cent of the approved production budget, with a cap of $10 million;
film projects with a production budget not exceeding $25 million
Since its launch in 2020, the Relaxation Plan has funded 23 film production projects

4.3.7 50% or more of the below-the-line expenditures for the implementation, Production, Completion and Delivery of the Film Project must be expended in Hong Kong. 4.3.8 The expenditure on Licensing Fees (including Original Work(s) / Story of Real Person(s) on which the Film Project is based (if any), Music, Footage and any Intellectual Property Right) must not exceed 10% of the actual production cost of the Film Project.
